Name: Odd Quality of Life
Author: Ltoddy
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/24738869-1746552537.png[/img][/center]
﻿
[center]Welcome to the Odd Quality of Life! This mod is a configurable bundle of quality of life features that I love to use when playing Stardew Valley. Many of these features have existed in older mods that have not been updated or use a different implementation overall. I have taken my own shot at designing these features with high configurability in mind.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/24738869-1746552009.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center]To install my mod manually:
[size=2]1. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2.  Select "Manual Download" from files
3. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods 
4. Run the game using SMAPI[/size]

To install using a mod manager:
1. Choose your favorite mod manager
2. Select "Mod Manager Download" from files

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/24738869-1746583318.png[/img]
Remove friendship decay﻿
Remove animal friendship decay
Autofill pet water bowls
Adjust fence decay
AFK pause (No more accidentally skipping 4 years)
Automatic fireplace
Fishing assistance tools
Sheering & Milking assistant (No more milking air + a hidden Easter egg)
Passable objects (Crops, Scarecrows, Sprinklers, Weeds, Trees, & Forage)
Auto stack ammo & bait
Festival notifications
Non-destructive NPC's
Non-destructive Lightning Strikes
Soundless Lightning Strikes
Changes for shops (Clint, Pierre, Marnie, Robin)
Unlimited legendary fish
Regenerate Stamina while sitting
Automatic gate opening/closing
Automatic Animal building door opening/closing w/ mod support such as for SVE
Plus more to come!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/24738869-1746551984.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center]﻿I strived to make my mod as configurable as possible in order to allow anyone to pick and choose the features and adjustments they want. Utilizing the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] you can edit the configurations for my mod from in game with some handy categories to help organize what configs you are adjusting. If you choose not to use GMCM, you can edit the configurations from the config file within the mods folder using your preferred text editor.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/24738869-1746736632.png[/img]
[url=https://github.com/Logoddy/Odd-Quality-of-Life]GitHub Repo﻿[/url]﻿

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/24738869-1746552037.png[/img]﻿[/center]

But I would be a terrible person if I didn't distinctly list the mods and authors that I used as inspiration and as guidelines for features to add into the QOL mod. The endless amount of shop reworks/changes/additions mods

Something to note is that I do not intend to replace any of these amazing mods and only seek to create highly configurable versions that I code in different ways to maintain uniqueness and make possible enhancements. I want to plainly say that any of these modders or anyone else for that matter is more than welcome to take any and all enhancements I have made in order to put into their own mods in the event that people do not want what is becoming a large mod with a wide variety of QOL options. What makes the Stardew Valley modding community great is our creativity and ability to work with each other providing feedback and suggestions to let anyone have the experience they want.

And obviously a big thanks to the SMAPI team for the modding API and Concerned Ape for this amazing game we all love![/center]
